name: autopilot-issue-delivery-worker
description: Use this skill to implement ONE microsoft/apm issue already selected by autopilot-issue-delivery-scheduler. Queue signal is `status/accepted` or a named bounded accept; that is not permission. Requires fresh human-scope evidence from scripts/governance before any mutate. May reproduce a bug, implement the accepted change, and open a fix PR. Not a queue manager and not a triage scheduler. Works in the scheduler's session, a child session, Cloud Agent, Remote Agent, or Agentic Workflow.
